route3D.name: Times Square to Central Park Walk

touristGuide.title: Times Square & Broadway
touristGuide.text: Times Square is the bustling commercial intersection in Midtown Manhattan. Famous for its massive digital billboards and Broadway theaters, millions of tourists walk through these bright streets every year. The energy here is electric, with street performers, iconic shops, and restaurants from around the world.

hotspots.example: You cannot park your car in front of a red fire hydrant in New York.
Take the stairs down at the subway entrance to catch the Uptown train.
Let's grab a quick snack at that street hot dog cart near the corner.

mission.title: Rainy Day Coffee Run
mission.description: Está chovendo em Manhattan. Entre na cafeteria da esquina e faça seu pedido em inglês.

steps.npcLine: Hi there! Welcome to Midtown Coffee. What can I get started for you today?

options.text: I'd like a medium iced latte with oat milk, to go, please.
options.feedback: Perfeito! 'To go' é a expressão natural nos EUA para pedir para viagem.

options.text: I want one coffee medium for travel now.
options.feedback: Quase! Nos EUA, evite 'I want' (soa ríspido) e use 'to go' em vez de 'for travel'.

steps.npcLine: Sure thing! Would you like any pastries or a bagel with that?

options.feedback: Excelente! 'That'll be all' encerra o pedido com naturalidade.
Essa frase significa que você já terminou de comer, não de pedir.

guide.title: Central Park
guide.text: Central Park is a huge green oasis in the middle of Manhattan. Locals jog, ride bikes and have picnics here, while tourists enjoy boat rides on the lake and long walks along the Mall.

touristGuide.title: Hoboken Waterfront & PATH Station
touristGuide.text: Located right across the Hudson River from Manhattan, Hoboken offers stunning skyline views and easy commuter train access for thousands of daily workers. The waterfront has been recently revitalized with parks, restaurants, and entertainment venues.

hotspots.example: Many people living in New Jersey take the commuter train to work in New York.
Take Exit 14 on the New Jersey Turnpike to reach Newark Airport.
New Jersey is famous for having a classic diner on almost every highway.

mission.title: Breakfast at a Jersey Diner
mission.description: Você entrou em um Diner clássico em Hoboken. Escolha seu café da manhã americano.

steps.npcLine: Morning, hon! Here's your menu. How would you like your eggs cooked?

options.text: Scrambled eggs with a side of hash browns, please.
options.feedback: Mandou bem! 'Scrambled eggs' (ovos mexidos) e 'hash browns' (batata ralada frita) são clássicos.

options.text: I want mixed eggs with fried potato.
options.feedback: Nos EUA o termo correto para ovos mexidos é 'scrambled eggs'.

guide.title: Hoboken Waterfront Walk
guide.text: The waterfront walkway runs along the Hudson River. Joggers, dog walkers and families come here for the skyline views, especially at sunset.

touristGuide.title: Austin Tech Hub & Space Innovation
touristGuide.text: Austin has transformed into a major technology and aerospace hub, attracting engineers, entrepreneurs, and startups from around the globe. The city's motto 'Keep Austin Weird' reflects its creative, innovative spirit.

hotspots.example: Engineers checked the rocket boosters on the launch pad before liftoff.
Texas barbecue is world-famous for its slow-smoked beef brisket.
The new electric vehicle factory is located on a massive tech campus.

mission.title: Tech Networking in Austin
mission.description: Você está em um evento de tecnologia em Austin. Apresente sua área de atuação com confiança.

steps.npcLine: Hey! Great conference today. What brings you out to Austin?

options.text: I'm here to connect with tech leaders and explore new software projects.
options.feedback: Excelente! Profissional, direto e muito natural em eventos nos EUA.

options.text: I came here because I like Elon Musk.
options.feedback: Embora seja verdade para muitos fãs, em um networking profissional vale focar nos seus objetivos!

guide.title: Silicon Hills Corridor
guide.text: North of downtown, the Silicon Hills corridor is full of startups, coworking spaces and coffee shops where founders meet investors every day.

touristGuide.title: Miami Beach & Ocean Drive
touristGuide.text: Miami Beach is known for its white sand beaches, Art Deco architecture, and vibrant nightlife. Ocean Drive features iconic pastel-colored buildings, trendy restaurants, and a diverse multicultural atmosphere.

hotspots.example: The colorful lifeguard towers are iconic symbols of Miami Beach.
After the beach, we grabbed a tropical smoothie to cool off.
Miami Beach features hundreds of restored Art Deco buildings from the 1920s and 30s.

mission.title: Beach Day Shopping
mission.description: Você está em uma loja de souvenirs em Miami Beach. Converse com o vendedor.

steps.npcLine: Welcome to Miami Beachside Souvenirs! Looking for anything special today?

options.text: Yes, I'm looking for an authentic Miami Beach souvenir to remember this trip.
options.feedback: Perfeito! Educado e específico. 'Authentic' e 'souvenir' são as palavras certas.

options.text: I want a thing to remember this place.
options.feedback: Mais natural seria: 'I'm looking for a souvenir' ou 'a memento of Miami Beach'.

guide.title: Mid-Beach Boardwalk
guide.text: The boardwalk is a quiet path above the sand. People walk, run and watch the sunrise here before the beach fills up.
